options.text: GET EVERY NEW MEMBER TO *DAY 90.*

items.current:

options.text:
GET EVERY NEW
MEMBER THERE.
options.why: A goal the owner sets, not a promise Tenure makes; reads aloud as one calm sentence.

THE DAY THAT
COUNTS.
options.why: The most understated, and shorter; drops the owner's task and the word members.

items.label: Starter template 1
where: the SAMPLE MESSAGE on every expo piece mirrors it
items.limits: Name ≤ 20 characters; body ≤ 160 characters with variables filled; GSM-7 characters only (no em dashes or curly quotes), so it sends as one text
items.current: We missed you — Hey {first}, we missed you this week. Want me to save you a spot in Thursday's 6 pm class? — Coach {coach}

options.text: We missed you — Hey {first}, we missed you this week. Want me to save you a spot in Thursday's 6 pm class? - Coach {coach}
options.why: Warm, specific, one easy question; it matches the SAMPLE MESSAGE printed on every piece.

options.text: We missed you — Hi {first}, we missed you this week. Want me to hold you a spot in Thursday's 6 pm class? - Coach {coach}
options.why: A shade calmer (Hi, hold); the expo SAMPLE MESSAGE would have to change with it.

items.label: Starter template 2
items.limits: Name ≤ 20 characters; body ≤ 160 characters with variables filled; GSM-7 characters only (no em dashes or curly quotes), so it sends as one text
items.current: Quick check-in — Hi {first}, it's {coach} from {gym}. How are your first few weeks going? Anything I can help with?

options.text: Quick check-in — Hi {first}, it's {coach} from {gym}. How are your first few weeks going? Anything I can help with?
options.why: Good body; the name "check-in" collides with the visits Tenure counts.

options.text: First weeks — Hi {first}, it's {coach} from {gym}. How are your first few weeks going? Tell me if I can help with anything.
options.why: Renamed to avoid the clash; one question instead of two.

items.label: Starter template 3
items.limits: Name ≤ 20 characters; body ≤ 160 characters with variables filled; keep one template using {days}; GSM-7 characters only (no em dashes or curly quotes), so it sends as one text
items.current: Back on track — Hey {first}, it's been {days} days. One visit this week gets you back on track. See you soon? — {coach}

options.text: Back on track — Hey {first}, it's been {days} days. One visit this week gets you back on track. See you soon? - {coach}
options.why: Direct, but counting days at someone reads as pressure, and "gets you back on track" is a promise.

options.text: One visit — Hi {first}, it's been {days} days since we saw you. One visit this week is a good restart. Want me to save you a spot? - {coach}
options.why: Keeps {days} as a plain fact, offers help, asks one easy question.

options.text: Good to see you — Hi {first}, it's {coach} from {gym}. It's been a little while. Want me to save you a spot this week?
options.why: The gentlest; drops {days}, so no starter shows that variable.
